programs.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
programs.desc: British POWs are ordered by their Japanese captors to construct a bridge of strategic importance and are happy to sabotage and delay the progress until their commanding officers orders them to continue the work unhindered to its completion, but are his actions tantamount to collaborating with the enemy?

programs.title: Shadow Island
programs.desc: Strange and mysterious occurrences plague a meteorologist when he travels to a deserted island to investigate his father's death.

programs.title: Ama Gloria
programs.desc: Cléo loves her nanny Gloria more than anything. When Gloria must return to homeland, the two must make the most of their last summer together.

programs.title: More Than Ever
programs.desc: Hélène and Mathieu have been happy together for many years. The bond between them is deep. Faced with an existential decision, Hélène travels alone to Norway to seek peace and meet a blogger she found on the internet.

programs.title: Goodbye Julia
programs.desc: Wracked by guilt after covering up a murder, Mona - a northern Sudanese retired singer in a tense marriage - tries to make amends by taking in the deceased's southern Sudanese widow, Julia, and her son, Daniel, into her home. Unable to confess her transgressions to Julia, Mona decides to leave the past behind and adjust to a new status quo, unaware that the country's turmoil may find its way into her home and put her face to face with her sins.

programs.title: Getaway Of Love
programs.desc: The destiny of Giuliana is radically changed when two robbers suddenly break into the supermarket where she works and take her hostage.
